name: Petro-king Oilfield Services Limited
summary: Petro-king Oilfield Services Limited, founded in 2002 and headquartered in Shenzhen, is an investment holding company providing oilfield technology services in China, the Middle East and elsewhere. Its segments are oilfield project tools and services, and consultancy services. It plans oilfield development, advises on procurement, installs equipment, manages projects in drilling and well completion, and trades oilfield tools. It was previously Termbray Petro-king Oilfield Services Limited.
